description: Marketing copy localization skill that converts English marketing copy (ads, landing pages, emails, CTAs) into native Egyptian Arabic عامية — or GCC dialect on request — with natural English code-switching for business terms. Use whenever marketing copy needs an Arabic version, an Arabic draft "sounds translated", or a bilingual campaign is being built. Rebuilds meaning per line instead of translating words; never outputs فصحى for performance marketing contexts.
